C.as_L_i_element: C = sum_{t=0}^{10} gamma_t theta^t with gamma_t = sum_j L_j * beta_{j t} ∈ K_proj (secondary multiply-add)

D.as_L_i_element: D = sum_{s,t} (sum_{j,k} M_jk beta_{j s} beta_{k t}) theta^{s+t} reduced mod mu

line_residual_binary_quadratic.defined_over: L_i (coeffs A in K_proj, C,D in L_i)
line_residual_binary_quadratic.note: Residual intersection of line(q,a_i) with X_gen after removing the known point a_i. Not a K_proj-quadratic unless C,D ∈ K_proj.
line_residual_binary_quadratic.object: A s^2 + 3 C s t + 3 D t^2 = 0 on P^1
